description: She wears a muted blue-teal full-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves, extensively bordered with gold-toned geometric and scrolling textile patterns. A broad decorated waist sash has round metal clasps and small hanging ornaments. A cream patterned underdress is visible along a modest lower front opening. A cream-and-blue woven wrap rests loosely around the forearms and drapes down both sides. Dark leather boots with gold-colored stitched decoration are visible at the hem. The fabrics appear substantial and opaque, with a fine woven texture; exact fiber content is uncertain. The upper chest and forearms are exposed while bust, abdomen and pelvis remain fully covered.
